question.text: Which section of PMLA defines the "Offence of Money Laundering"?

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 3 of PMLA defines the offence of money laundering, covering whoever directly or indirectly attempts to indulge or knowingly assists or is a party to any process connected with proceeds of crime, including concealment, possession, acquisition, use, or projecting/claiming them as untainted property. The Trap: Section 2 contains the definitions, while Sections 4, 5, and 12 deal with other matters listed alongside Section 3 in the workbook. They are sequentially related but address different aspects of the Act. Note: Pages 27-28 of the NISM Series XXIV workbook and the sample question on page 34 support that Section 3 defines the offence of money laundering; page 28 also lists Sections 2, 4, 5, and 12 alongside Section 3.
